## Overview 
To assess the robustness of the intermediate population and determine whether it could be identified independently of the tumour compartment, the SCNA-based clustering analysis using only cells from the normal fallopian tube epithelium is shown here.

First, required libraries are loaded
```{r load libraries, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(SpatialCopyInference)
library(dplyr) 
library(ggplot2) 
library(Seurat)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

## Data import
To reproduce this example, first download the Xenium output files from:
<https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/xenium-prime-ffpe-human-ovarian-cancer>

```{r Import data example paths, eval = FALSE}
# Path to Xenium output directory
data_dir <- "path/to/Xenium_outputs/outs"

# Path to refined cell type annotations
annotation_file <- "path/to/cell_type_annotations.csv"
```

```{r Import data, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Import data
xenium.obj <- import_xenium(data_dir, annotation_file)
```

Next, epithelial cells  belonging to the histologically normal fallopian tube region are subset.
```{r Subset, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Subset normal region
box <- list(xmin = 7800, xmax = 10100, ymin = 3750, ymax = 6050)

coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(xenium.obj, image = "fov")
cells_keep <- colnames(xenium.obj)[
  coords$x > box$xmin & 
  coords$x < box$xmax &
  coords$y > box$ymin & 
  coords$y < box$ymax]

xenium.sub <- subset(xenium.obj, cells = cells_keep)

# Keep epithelial cell types only
epithelial_cells <- c("Fallopian Tube Epithelium","Secretory Epithelial Cells","Ciliated Epithelial Cells")

xenium.sub <- subset(xenium.sub, subset = group %in% epithelial_cells)

# Inspect retained cells
table(xenium.sub$group)
dim(xenium.sub)

# Remove full Xenium object to reduce memory usage
rm(xenium.obj)
gc()
```

## Run pipeline
To determine whether the intermediate population can be identified independently of tumour-associated cells, the SpatialCopyInference workflow is repeated using only epithelial cells from the normal fallopian tube region. 
```{r Run pipeline, out.width="100%", warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Quality control
xenium.sub <- filter_cells(xenium.sub)
xenium.sub <- filter_genes(xenium.sub, min_cells = 1, min_counts = 1)

# Normalisation
xenium.sub <- normalise_data(xenium.sub)

# Compute chromosome arm means 
arm_means <- compute_arm_means(xenium.sub, min_genes_per_arm = 20)

# SCNA inference
arm_ratios <- compute_arm_ratios(arm_means, 
                                 xenium.sub)

# Spatial clustering
BANKSY.obj <- compute_spatial_clusters(arm_ratios = arm_ratios,
          xenium.sub,
          k_geom = 20,
          lambda = 0.8,
          resolution = 0.3)

xenium.sub <- add_banksy_clusters(xenium.sub, BANKSY.obj,
                                  resolution = 0.3)
```

## Visualisation
```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 1.5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Supplementary Figure 5A: Heatmap of chromosome arm-level SCNA log ratio profiles
heatmaps <- plot_cluster_heatmaps(BANKSY.obj,
            resolutions = 0.3)

heatmaps$res_0.3
```

```{r, out.width = "100%", fig.height = 4, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Supplementary Figure 5B: Cell type distribution of the normal fallopian tube epithelial populations
plot_df <- cbind(
  xenium.sub@meta.data,
  GetTissueCoordinates(xenium.sub, image = "fov")
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, stroke = 0) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Fallopian Tube Epithelium" = "#59A14F",
      "Secretory Epithelial Cells" = "#F28E2B",
      "Ciliated Epithelial Cells" = "#4E79A7"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "left",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 4)
    )
  )

# Supplementary Figure 5C: Spatial distribution of the SCNA-defined clusters
plots <- plot_spatial_clusters(xenium.sub,
                               cluster_palette = c("#F28E2B","#8CD17D"))

plots$spatial_clusters_plot
```

## Compare with intermediate population
Overlap with original intermediate cluster using entire population is shown here.
```{r Comparison, out.width = "100%", fig.height = 4, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Import BANKSY clusters derived from entire population
banksy_entire <- read.csv(
  "Data/cell_ovarian_banksy_clusters.csv"
)

# Intermediate cluster from whole-tissue analysis
banksy_intermediate_2 <- banksy_entire %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    group == 3,
    cell_id %in% colnames(xenium.sub)
  )

# Cluster 2 from FTE-only analysis
banksy_early <- data.frame(
  cell_id = colnames(BANKSY.obj),
  group = BANKSY.obj@meta.data[["BANKSY_snn_res.0.3"]]
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == 2)

# Shared cells
shared_cells <- banksy_early %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    cell_id %in% banksy_intermediate_2$cell_id
  )

# Calculate overlap percentage
overlap_pct <- round(
  100 * nrow(shared_cells) / nrow(banksy_intermediate_2),
  1
)

overlap_label <- paste0(
  "Overlap with Cluster 2 (",
  overlap_pct,
  "%)"
)

# Plotting data
df_plot <- cbind(
  xenium.sub@meta.data,
  GetTissueCoordinates(xenium.sub, image = "fov")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell_id = rownames(.),
    intermediate_cluster = ifelse(
      cell_id %in% banksy_intermediate_2$cell_id,
      "Intermediate Cluster",
      "Other"
    ),
    overlap_simple = dplyr::case_when(
      cell_id %in% shared_cells$cell_id ~ overlap_label,
      cell_id %in% banksy_intermediate_2$cell_id ~ "Intermediate Cluster",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

df_plot$overlap_simple <- factor(
  df_plot$overlap_simple,
  levels = c(
    "Other",
    "Intermediate Cluster",
    overlap_label
  )
)

# Colours
overlap_cols <- c(
  "Other" = "grey90",
  "Intermediate Cluster" = "#fbb4ae"
)

overlap_cols <- c(
  overlap_cols,
  setNames("#6a3d9a", overlap_label)
)

# Supplementary Figure 5E:
# Overlap between the intermediate cluster and SCNA-defined Cluster 2
ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    colour = overlap_simple
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.3,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = overlap_cols,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_void() +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 4),
      ncol = 1
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key.height = unit(2, "mm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "mm")
  )

# Supplementary Figure 5D:
# Spatial distribution of the intermediate cluster identified in the
# full population within the normal fallopian tube epithelium
ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    colour = intermediate_cluster
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.3,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Other" = "grey90",
      "Intermediate Cluster" = "#fbb4ae"
    ),
    breaks = "Intermediate Cluster",
    name = NULL
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      size = 9
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 4)
    )
  )
```
